new_sentence: The detector keys on the UNIFORMITY of the edit, not on who uploaded it: it fires on uniform all-layer projections and misses per-component-optimised and depth-weighted kernels, which is a recipe property stated in advance and confirmed by a synthetic layer-fraction sweep with f* = 1.00.
old_framing_paraphrase: the detector generalises across uploaders; the four new-uploader checkpoints are framed as an UPLOADER generalisation test
supporting_numbers: 2/4 misses carry a verbatim non-uniform kernel string

new_sentence: We characterise the detector's scope as RECIPE-CLASS BOUNDED: uniform global projection is detected at AUROC 1.000; per-component-optimised (Heretic) kernels are not.
2 of the 4 misses carry a verbatim non-uniform kernel string, so at least 2/4 of the 0.382 new-uploader AUROC is a RECIPE effect; the residual (2) is unattributed and reported as such.
old_framing_paraphrase: 0.382 AUROC reported as a failure to generalise to new uploaders

new_sentence: W05 requires a uniform, complete annihilation in every layer; any depth-weighted or sub-unit-weight kernel escapes it, exactly as a band-limited edit does.
old_framing_paraphrase: the miss is attributed to uploader-specific implementation drift

new_sentence: Broader uploader coverage would not fix the gap; broader RECIPE coverage is what the scope statement requires, and the sub-4.2B MPOA / Heretic / OBLITERATUS checkpoints make that test runnable today.
old_framing_paraphrase: concludes that broader uploader coverage would fix the gap
supporting_numbers: 4,022,468,096 params on the panel's own Qwen3-4B family

new_sentence: DELETE. Mechanically different recipes DO exist below the ceiling.
old_framing_paraphrase: no mechanically different recipe exists below the 4.2B ceiling

refutation.note: Three of the four 'missing' recipes have public sub-4.2B checkpoints at 4,022,468,096 params on the panel's OWN Qwen3-4B family, and the experiment already measured two Heretic checkpoints without recognising them as a distinct recipe class. Only ORBA is genuinely empty at this scale (7 repos, all 12.187B).
